violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. CFSM application left with person in charge. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/21/2025

Commercially processed popcorn chicken was observed held at 125 degrees Fahrenheit. Food was observed "double panned" in the steam table. Foods were moved into separate hotel pans and reheated to 155 in steam table. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Hot foods log left on-site for staff to fill out daily. Logs to be reviewed at next inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026
